title: Prosciutto and Melon Salad
description: A refreshing no-cook summer salad with sweet melon, salty prosciutto, creamy mozzarella, and peppery arugula.

steps.instruction: Zest the lemon over the melon pieces.
Place arugula and basil in a large bowl or platter.
Season greens with salt and pepper, drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil, and squeeze lemon juice over. Toss gently.
Top with melon, mozzarella, and prosciutto.
Season lightly with salt and pepper and drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed, then serve immediately.
